title: 水庫異重流排砂~Density-current venting for reservoir sediment
focus: 以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流~Analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture
summary: 本課以以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流為主線，先用懸浮濃度與混合密度與約化重力與浮力界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降時間與粒徑、底孔捕捉與排出連結到底流質量帳與殘留。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture through Suspension concentration and mixture density and Reduced gravity and buoyancy, then connects Settling time and particle size and Low-outlet capture and export to Current mass budget and residual storage. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查懸浮濃度與混合密度：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3；再獨立檢查約化重力與浮力：g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2。敏感度：水與顆粒密度不變時，體積濃度由0.005增至0.010使密度差與約化重力加倍；固定流深下重力速度尺度增加平方根2倍，並非速度必然加倍。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 將先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Suspension concentration and mixture density: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. Independently examine Reduced gravity and buoyancy: g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2. Sensitivity: at fixed water and grain densities, raising volume concentration from0.005 to0.010 doubles density excess and reduced gravity. At fixed layer depth the gravity-velocity scale rises bysqrt(2), not by a factor of2. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Use the following independent check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 懸浮濃度與混合密度~Suspension concentration and mixture density
units.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度~Suspension concentration and mixture density
units.mechanism: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。 驗證時應同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion. Measure both ambient and incoming water before inferring plunging behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 約化重力與浮力~Reduced gravity and buoyancy
units.title: 約化重力與浮力~Reduced gravity and buoyancy
units.mechanism: 約化重力以密度差相對背景密度縮放重力，表達異重流的浮力驅動尺度。分母選用哪個參考密度須一致，小密度差近似不能任意延伸至高濃度泥流；密度差沿程因捲吸與沉降變化，因此不是固定材料常數。 驗證時應沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差，並辨識以下失效情境：把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess. Use a consistent reference density and do not extend a small-density-difference approximation to dense debris flows. Entrainment and settling change the excess along the route, so reduced gravity is a changing flow property rather than a material constant. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 密度福祿數與流態~Densimetric Froude number and regime
units.title: 密度福祿數與流態~Densimetric Froude number and regime
units.mechanism: 密度福祿數比較流速與層內重力波尺度，有助整理潛入與底流工況。流層厚度須由密度或濃度剖面定義，不能直接用水庫總深；真實前緣與非均勻分層不一定符合均勻兩層模型，需要以觀測檢查。 驗證時應用密度剖面界定流層厚度並量測流速與前緣位置，並辨識以下失效情境：把全庫深當流層厚度會低估密度福祿數。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Densimetric Froude number compares current speed with an internal gravity-wave scale. Define layer thickness from density or concentration profiles rather than total reservoir depth. A real head and nonuniform stratification can depart from the uniform two-layer model, requiring observations before interpreting the number. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Define layer depth from density profiles and measure speed and front position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total reservoir depth as current thickness understates densimetric Froude number. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=0.50 m/s; reducedG=0.16 m/s2; layerDepth=2 m; FrD=0.50/sqrt(0.16*2)=0.883883。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: V=0.50 m/s; reducedG=0.16 m/s2; layerDepth=2 m; FrD=0.50/sqrt(0.16*2)=0.883883. units.anchor: 前緣行程與時窗~Front travel and timing window
units.title: 前緣行程與時窗~Front travel and timing window
units.mechanism: 底流前緣抵達壩前的時間受沿程坡度、捲吸及沉降改變，平均速度只提供第一輪時窗估算。它不是即時開門指令，實際需靠沿庫監測更新；應區分前緣速度與流層內平均速度，兩者不可直接互換。 驗證時應以多站濁度及密度到時比對前緣速度並更新抵達區間，並辨識以下失效情境：沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Front arrival depends on slope, entrainment and settling along the route. A mean-speed estimate supplies an initial time window rather than an operating command. Update it with distributed observations and distinguish front speed from mean velocity within the layer, which need not be equal. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare arrival times at multiple turbidity and density stations and update the arrival interval. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 沉降時間與粒徑~Settling time and particle size
units.title: 沉降時間與粒徑~Settling time and particle size
units.mechanism: 顆粒沉降會降低底流密度並改變可排出的粒徑組成，沉速受粒徑、形狀、絮凝及濃度影響。指定沉速的距離時間比只表示靜水尺度，紊流再懸浮會延長停留；不同粒徑不能共用一個沉速來預測全部排砂效率。 驗證時應採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面，並辨識以下失效情境：用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Settling reduces density and changes the size distribution available for venting. Speed depends on size, shape, flocculation and concentration. Depth divided by prescribed settling speed is a still-water scale; turbulence can extend suspension, and one settling speed cannot represent the efficiency for all fractions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 捲吸稀釋與濃度~Entrainment dilution and concentration
units.title: 捲吸稀釋與濃度~Entrainment dilution and concentration
units.mechanism: 底流捲吸上層清水會增加水量並降低濃度，在無沉降與再侵蝕的短段可用泥砂質量守恆估算。此式不是實際捲吸率模型，捲吸量須另有依據；若床面供砂或沉降顯著，就要補上來源與匯項。 驗證時應以沿程流量與濃度同步量測核對質量是否守恆，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略床面再侵蝕會把濃度維持誤解為完全沒有捲吸。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Entrainment increases water volume and dilutes concentration. Over a short reach without deposition or erosion, sediment conservation estimates the resulting concentration. It does not predict entrainment rate, which needs independent evidence; add source and sink terms when the bed exchanges sediment with the flow. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure flow and concentration along the reach to check sediment mass conservation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring bed erosion can make sustained concentration look like absent entrainment. units.anchor: 底孔捕捉與排出~Low-outlet capture and export
units.title: 底孔捕捉與排出~Low-outlet capture and export
units.mechanism: 底孔能否捕捉異重流取決於流層高度、入口位置及抽取範圍，開門流量大不一定全部來自高濃度底層。排出濃度需由水樣量測，不能直接代入壩前最高濃度；應把清水摻入與捕捉效率分開。 驗證時應同步量測壩前垂向濃度與出口濃度並檢查抽取層位，並辨識以下失效情境：入口過高可能主要抽出清水而非底部高濃度流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Low-outlet capture depends on layer depth, inlet elevation and withdrawal geometry. A large release need not consist entirely of dense bottom water. Measure outlet concentration rather than substituting the maximum near-dam value, and distinguish clear-water dilution from capture efficiency. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure vertical concentration near the dam and at the outlet to identify withdrawal depth. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A high inlet may withdraw mostly clear water instead of the dense bottom layer. units.anchor: 事件排砂效率~Event venting efficiency
units.title: 事件排砂效率~Event venting efficiency
units.mechanism: 排砂效率須明定分母是入庫總砂、抵達壩前底流砂或可捕捉粒徑砂，否則不同研究數值不可比較。事件質量積分比只適用相同起訖時間；殘留在庫底的砂與延後排出的部分需另外列帳，避免雙重計入。 驗證時應先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量，並辨識以下失效情境：混用入庫砂與到壩砂分母會產生無意義的效率比較。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Define whether efficiency uses total incoming sediment, sediment reaching the dam or a capturable size fraction. These denominators produce different metrics. Integrate over matching time windows and separately record retained and delayed export to avoid comparing unlike studies or counting the same sediment twice. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons. Observe near and far fields rather than treating the average as compliance everywhere. units.anchor: 底流質量帳與殘留~Current mass budget and residual storage
